entries.explanation: Stabilize a dying creature or grant temporary hit points with a Medicine check during combat.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Administer First Aid

entries.explanation: Weapon trait that reduces the multiple attack penalty on later Strikes with that weapon.
Prepare to help an ally; if your roll beats the DC, they gain a bonus to their check.
d20 roll plus modifiers versus a target’s AC (or other defense) to see if an attack hits.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Attack Rolls

entries.explanation: Look away from a visual threat to avoid its worst effect, often at the cost of awareness.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Avert Gaze

entries.explanation: Stealth check to travel without drawing attention while the party explores.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Avoid Notice

entries.explanation: Weapon trait that deals extra precision damage when you hit an off-guard foe.
Acrobatics check to move across a narrow or unstable surface without falling.
Sent to another plane or dimension; you cannot act on your current plane until the effect ends.
Cannot see; you automatically fail sight-based checks and attacks against you may gain benefits.
Clever quip or performance that boosts allies or unsettles listeners.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Bon Mot

entries.explanation: Use the spellcasting action appropriate to the spell’s casting time to produce a magical effect.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Cast a Spell

entries.explanation: Athletics check to scale a surface; failure may mean a fall or no progress.
Your clumsy value penalizes Dexterity-based checks and DCs until it decreases.
Intimidation check to bully someone into cooperating for a short time.
Direct an animal companion or similar ally to take a specific action on its turn.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Command an Animal

entries.explanation: Harder to see clearly; creatures must succeed at a flat check to target you with some effects.
Mentally disoriented; you may attack the wrong target or act unpredictably until the condition ends.
Another creature directs your actions; you follow their orders until the effect ends.
Use spell rank and a skill check to end an ongoing spell or magical effect on a target.
Terrain or obstacles grant a circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves against area effects.
Move while prone at half Speed without standing up first.
Distract foes so allies can slip away or set up a better position.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Create a Diversion

entries.explanation: Miss the DC or AC by 10 or more (or roll a natural 1 on an attack) for a worse outcome.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Degrees of Success

entries.explanation: Beat the DC or AC by 10 or more (or roll a natural 20 on an attack) for an improved outcome.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Degrees of Success

entries.explanation: Afflicted by a curse; your cursed value imposes penalties until the curse is removed.
Visual overload; you take a penalty on sight-based Perception checks until the effect ends.
Weapon trait that adds extra damage dice on a critical hit.
Cannot hear; you automatically fail hearing-based checks and some auditory effects fail.
Society check to read an unknown script, cipher, or archaic document.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Decipher Writing

entries.explanation: Fortify a camp or position against attack while the party rests or works.
Compare your roll to the DC: critical success beats by 10+, success meets DC, failure misses, critical failure fails by 10+.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Degrees of Success

entries.explanation: Push your turn later in the initiative order so you can act after allies or react to foes.
Use Intimidation to frighten a foe within range who can perceive you.
Sense magical auras within range; reveals presence, school, and strength of magic on objects or creatures.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Spells — Detect Magic

entries.explanation: Athletics check to knock an item from a foe’s grasp on a success.
Fate turns against you; your doomed value makes death more likely when you reach dying.
Life force sapped; your drained value reduces your maximum Hit Points until it decreases.
Release something you are holding, leaving it in your space or nearby.
At 0 HP and losing life; you must attempt recovery checks or worsen toward death each round.
Use a skill or lore to work for pay between adventures over downtime.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Earn Income

entries.explanation: Weakened physically; your enfeebled value penalizes Strength-based checks and DCs.
Athletics or Acrobatics check to break free from grab, restraint, or similar immobilization.
Captivated by something; you cannot use concentrate actions except to focus on the source until it ends.
Worn out from exertion; you cannot gain temporary Hit Points and may take other penalties.
Deception check to make a foe off-guard to your melee attacks until the end of your turn.
Weapon trait letting you use Dexterity instead of Strength on attack and damage rolls.
You and an ally opposite a foe give each other flanking, making the target off-guard to your melee attacks.
Roll d20 against a fixed DC with no modifiers; used to end persistent damage and similar effects.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Flat Checks

entries.explanation: Stay close to a guide to move faster and safer through unfamiliar terrain.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Follow the Expert

entries.explanation: Weapon trait that can push a target back on a critical hit.
Resist physical effects such as poison, disease, or bodily harm using your Constitution modifier.
Costs no actions to use; only available when a rule or ability explicitly grants it.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Free Actions

entries.explanation: Shaken by fear; your frightened value reduces all your checks and DCs until it decreases at the end of your turn.
Diplomacy check to collect rumors and leads by talking with locals.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Gather Information

entries.explanation: Held by another creature; you are off-guard and cannot move until you Escape or the grab ends.
Athletics check to grab a foe; success imposes the grabbed condition until it ends.
Spend to reroll a check, avoid death, or use a class feat — usually one per session unless you earn more.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Hero Points

entries.explanation: Undetected by some creatures; they must Seek or guess your square to target you.
Attempt to become hidden using Stealth against observers’ Perception.
Move faster than a normal Stride while exploring, often at the cost of Perception or stealth.
Crafting check to recognize alchemical items, poisons, or reagents.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Identify Alchemy

entries.explanation: Use a magical tradition skill to learn the properties of a magic item or effect.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Identify Magic

entries.explanation: You cannot use any action with the move trait; external forces or magic pin you in place.
Perception roll at combat start to determine turn order for all participants.
Draw, stow, pick up, or manipulate an object you can reach — one action in most cases.
Cannot be seen; you are undetected to creatures that cannot perceive you otherwise.
Weapon trait that can knock a foe prone on a critical hit.
Jump horizontally or vertically up to your maximum Leap distance without a check.
Deception check to convince someone of a falsehood without being caught.
Action trait requiring at least one free hand to interact with objects.
Each attack action after the first in your turn imposes a cumulative penalty on later attack rolls until your turn ends.
You are flat-footed to attackers you cannot see or who have you at a serious positional disadvantage; they often gain benefits against your AC.
Thievery check to secretly pick up or palm a small unattended object.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Palm an Object

entries.explanation: Frozen in place; you cannot act and are off-guard until the paralysis ends.
Wisdom-based skill for noticing threats, searching, and rolling initiative in many encounters.
Entertain a crowd or earn coin with music, dance, oratory, or similar art.
Damage that repeats at the end of your turn until you succeed at a flat check to end it.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Combat — Persistent Damage

entries.explanation: Turned to stone; you are immobilized, cannot act, and have object immunities until the effect is removed.
Indicate a hidden creature’s location so allies know where to target or seek.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Point Out

entries.explanation: You are lying on the ground; melee attacks against you can be easier while ranged attacks can be harder until you Stand.
You gain an extra action at the start of your turn from a spell or effect.
Gain your shield’s circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Raise Shield

entries.explanation: How many squares away you can Strike with a melee weapon; most reach weapons extend your threat beyond adjacent squares.
Special action triggered by a defined event; you get one reaction per round unless an effect says otherwise.
Reaction when a foe triggers it by moving or manipulating within reach; make a melee Strike against that creature.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Reactive Strike

entries.explanation: Spend an action to define a trigger; you use a reaction when the trigger occurs.
Use a Lore or relevant skill to remember useful facts about a creature, object, or topic.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Recall Knowledge

entries.explanation: Dodge sudden danger such as explosions or traps using your Dexterity modifier.
Free a creature you have grabbed or restrained so it is no longer held.
Diplomacy check to ask a favor or cooperation from someone who is not hostile.
Bound or entangled; you are off-guard, cannot use move actions, and have limited options until you break free.
Fortitude, Reflex, or Will defense roll against an effect’s DC to resist harm or conditions.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Core — Saving Throws

entries.explanation: Survey ahead for danger or points of interest while the party travels.
Scan for hidden or undetected creatures and objects using Perception.
Perception check to tell if someone is lying or hiding their intent.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Sense Motive

entries.explanation: Reaction when you take damage while your shield is raised to reduce damage with hardness.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Feats — Shield Block

entries.explanation: Athletics check to push a foe back 5 feet or knock them prone.
Nauseated or ill; your sickened value penalizes your checks and DCs until it decreases.
You have fewer actions at the start of your turn because of hindering magic or effects.
Move while trying to stay undetected, rolling Stealth against observers.
Medicine check to keep a dying creature from losing more Hit Points before healing.
Rise from prone to standing; costs an action unless an ability says otherwise.
Thievery check to lift an object from a person without being noticed.
Move 5 feet without triggering reactions that care about your movement leaving a square.
Move up to your Speed; basic movement action used to reposition on the battlefield.
Make a melee or ranged attack with a weapon or unarmed attack; roll against the target’s AC.
Dazed or reeling; you lose actions at the start of your turn based on your stunned value.
Mentally dulled; your stupefied value penalizes mental checks, DCs, and spell rolls.
Survival check to find food and water for yourself in the wild.
Spend an action to extend the duration of a spell you are already concentrating on.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Sustain a Spell

entries.explanation: Weapon trait letting you attack multiple adjacent foes with one Strike.
Athletics check to move through water; currents and armor can impose penalties.
Hunker behind cover to gain its circumstance bonus until you move away.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Take Cover

entries.explanation: On your turn you usually have three actions and one reaction; most activities cost one or more actions.
Weapon trait for items designed to be hurled; uses a thrown range increment.
Survival check to follow signs of a creature or party through the wilderness.
Medicine check to help a poisoned ally; may reduce stage or grant a bonus on their next save against the poison.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Treat Poison

entries.explanation: Medicine activity to heal hit points outside combat over a span of time.
entries.citation: Pathfinder Player Core (Remaster) — Actions — Treat Wounds

entries.explanation: Athletics check to knock a target prone if you succeed against their Reflex DC.
Weapon trait treating a one-handed weapon as if you were wielding two copies for flurry attacks.
Knocked out; you cannot act and are off-guard until you regain consciousness.
Weapon trait allowing one- or two-handed use with different damage dice.
Ranged weapon trait penalizing shots made against targets closer than the listed distance.
Resist mental effects such as charms or fear using your Wisdom modifier.
Serious injury stacks when you regain consciousness from dying, making future recovery harder.
